title: Mass Layoffs in Iran as Businesses Buckle Under Wartime Pressures

title: Trump Administration Is Considering Pausing the Federal Gas Tax to Lower Prices, Energy Secretary Says
partialText: The tax is a little over 18 cents a gallon for gasoline. With the average national price above $4.50, the measure will provide little relief.

title: Lebanese Mourn Eight Members of One Family Killed in Israeli Strike
partialText: Israel has escalated attacks on Lebanon since Thursday, further unraveling a truce in its war with Hezbollah. Among those killed on Saturday was a 6-month-old infant, relatives said.

title: After Virginia Redistricting Map Is Tossed, Democrats Search Desperately for a Response

title: One Big Headache for Politicians These Days: a Messy Digital Footprint

title: After Capturing Maduro, Trump Celebrated Victory. Did It Bring Venezuelans Home?
partialText: Dire conditions in Venezuela prompted an exodus. In the wake of the attack that ousted its top leader, the question is whether things have changed enough to make a return appealing.

title: U.S.-China Rivalry Reaches South American Skies

title: Why the Trump-Xi Summit Matters, Even if Little Seems to Come of It
partialText: The war in Iran, trade, artificial intelligence and Taiwan are expected to be on the agenda. But expectations are modest.

title: Cruise Ship Linked to Hantavirus Outbreak Arrives in Spain’s Canary Islands for Disembarking
partialText: Small groups of passengers and crew disembarked from the ship after it anchored off Spain’s Canary Islands on Sunday. People were expected to fly to their home countries through Monday, officials said.

title: British Paratroopers Deliver Aid to Remote Islands With Possible Hantavirus Case
partialText: The British military took critical medical supplies to Tristan da Cunha, a tiny British archipelago where authorities have identified a suspected hantavirus case.
